name: economy
description: Guild bank with wallet and vault balances, payday, taxed transfers, slots, and a fully audited transaction ledger.
short: Guild currency with payday, transfers, slots, and an audit ledger.
endUserDataStatement: Stores user ID with wallet and bank balances, payday timestamps, and a transaction history per server. Deleted on GDPR erasure.

configFields.label: Currency Name
configFields.description: Name of the server currency shown on balances.

configFields.label: Currency Emoji
configFields.description: Emoji shown next to currency amounts.

configFields.label: Starting Wallet
configFields.description: Wallet balance granted to a member's first account.

configFields.label: Starting Bank
configFields.description: Bank balance granted to a member's first account.

configFields.label: Maximum Balance
configFields.description: Wallet plus bank can never exceed this total.

configFields.label: Payday Amount
configFields.description: Currency granted by each payday claim.

configFields.label: Payday Cooldown
configFields.description: How long a member waits between payday claims.

configFields.label: Transfer Tax (%)
configFields.description: Percentage burned on every member-to-member transfer.

configFields.label: Slots Cooldown
configFields.description: How long a member waits between slot pulls.

configFields.label: Slots Daily Wager Cap
configFields.description: Maximum total a member may wager on slots per day. 0 disables the cap.

configFields.label: Slots Payouts
configFields.description: Slot machine multipliers as key:multiplier entries (jackpot, cloverThree, cherriesThree, twoSix, cherriesTwo, threeKind, twoKind).
